criteria.name: Task Response
criteria.feedback: Well-developed position with balanced evaluation of both perspectives and relevant real-world support.

criteria.feedback: Clear paragraph progression and logical cohesive ties; avoid overusing sentence-initial adverbs.

criteria.feedback: Good mix of complex subordinate clauses and passive voice; double-check article consistency.
